title: STA: A Split Temporal Adversary Method for Evaluating Robustness of Multimodal RL-based Driving Policies
abstract: arXiv:2611.20765v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal reinforcement learning (MRL) offers a promising paradigm for autonomous driving by jointly leveraging complementary sensor observations to learn effective decision-making policies. However, its effectiveness critically depends on temporal alignment across modalities, making temporal inconsistency a fundamental vulnerability. Even subtle misalignment or latency can corrupt fused representations and ultimately lead to decision failures. Existing studies have explored adversarial attacks to induce cross-modal temporal inconsistencies, thereby enabling systematic evaluation of the temporal robustness of MRL policies. However, existing methods remain limited in generality, realism, and adaptivity. translated_title: STA：一种用于评估多模态强化学习驾驶策略鲁棒性的分裂时序对抗方法
translated_abstract: 多模态强化学习（MRL）通过联合利用互补的传感器观测来学习有效的决策策略，为自动驾驶提供了一种有前景的范式。然而，其有效性关键依赖于模态间的时间对齐，这使得时间不一致性成为一个根本性的脆弱点。即使是微小的错位或延迟也可能破坏融合表征，并最终导致决策失败。已有研究探索了对抗攻击来诱导跨模态时间不一致性，从而实现对MRL策略时间鲁棒性的系统性评估。然而，现有方法在通用性、真实性和自适应性方面仍然有限。为解决这些局限，我们提出了分裂时序对抗方法（STA），它将多模态时间攻击表述为一个统一的决策过程，在真实的策略-攻击者交互下联合优化攻击时机与模态选择。
tldr: 提出分裂时序对抗方法（STA），将多模态时间攻击统一建模为决策过程，联合优化攻击时机与模态选择，以系统性评估多模态强化学习自动驾驶策略在时间不一致性下的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Split Temporal Adversary (STA), which formulates multimodal temporal attacks as a unified decision process that jointly optimizes attack timing and modality selection, enabling systematic evaluation of the temporal robustness of multimodal RL-based driving policies.
